rationale: Micah's work on visual interfaces for machine learning systems and graph data could directly apply to Yuichiro's computational materials research—making complex molecular dynamics simulations and Bayesian optimization results more interpretable through interactive visualization. While Micah is building AI tooling and Yuichiro is applying computational methods in materials science, there's a natural fit where Micah's d3.js and WebXR expertise could unlock new ways to explore polymer force fields and simulation outputs that are typically opaque to researchers.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Asoma Yuichiro — his work on molecular dynamics simulation and materials informatics could benefit from the visual interfaces for complex data you're pioneering at IntentiveAI.
